artworks.title: John Wallis, Mathematician
artworks.description: The image shows a man facing forward from the chest up in a portrait style. His facial features include deep-set eyes, a long nose, and shoulder-length straight dark hair. He wears a cap on his head and formal attire with a white collar typical of the historical period. There is an oval frame with intricate line patterns and a crest featuring heraldic symbols below it around him. The background consists of fine horizontal lines for texture.

artworks.title: Sir George Wharton, Royalist and Astrologer
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure from the chest up. He is slightly turned to his left, with his face towards the viewer. The man has a long face with prominent cheekbones and a mustache. His long, curly hair flows past his shoulders. He wears historical clothing, including a dark coat with a white upturned collar and an intricate cravat. There are no visible accessories on him. The background features a textured frame surrounding the subject in an oval shape with a decorative pattern of leaves and ribbon-like designs. Below the portrait is a wide rectangular area with ornate text.

artworks.title: Louise Renee de Penancoet de Keroualle, Duchess of Portsmouth
artworks.artist: Edward Davis after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman seated with her upper body and part of her lower body visible. She is sitting in a three-quarter view with her head slightly turned towards the viewer. The woman has refined facial features, curly hair falling to her shoulders, and is wearing a luxurious gown with ruffled details. She holds a bouquet of flowers in her left hand. In the background, there is a carved architectural column on the left and a draped curtain on the right. Additionally, sculptural figures of cherubs are visible beside her.

artworks.title: Dr. Gideon Harvey, Physician of Charles II and James II
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man with distinctive facial features, wearing a dark coat with a white lace collar. He is posing with one hand raised and another resting on a model of a skeleton. In the background, another figure is visible holding a round flask. The background is intricately patterned and beneath the portrait is a Latin inscription and the name Gideon Harvey.

artworks.title: Captain Samuel Sturmy, Navigator
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man from waist up. He has long, curly hair falling to his shoulders, a prominent nose, arched eyebrows, and a subtle mustache with a pointed goatee. The man is dressed in period attire with a buttoned jacket, wide sleeves, lace cuffs, and a cravat at his neck. He holds a globe with one hand resting on it. Surrounding him is an ornate oval wreath with scrolls displaying text. The background includes a dark, crosshatched area with a small motif of a building and hanging fabric. A coat of arms featuring a lion is in the top left corner of the image.

artworks.title: Title Page for Ecclesia Anglicana, by J. Ganden
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand architectural facade with symbolic and religious elements. The drawing features a detailed facade of a Gothic-style building, possibly a church, with pointed spires and a central circular emblem. The emblem contains the image of a pelican and is set within a richly decorated oval frame. Above the entrance, there are two niches; one houses a figure in armor and the other a robed figure holding a book. The central doorway is flanked by columns and crowned with the inscription "ECCLESIA ANGLICANA." Below, a figure in religious garb, lying on the steps and holding a large cross, appears contemplative beside a basin filled with water.

artworks.title: John Gadbury, Astrologer
artworks.description: This is a black and white engraved portrait showing a man's head and shoulders facing slightly to the right. His facial features are detailed, with a strong chin, broad nose, and a neutral expression. He has long, wavy hair falling to his shoulders and wears a dark garment with a high white collar. The portrait is set within an oval border with decorative edges. In the top left corner, there is an illustration of a sun with a face, and in the top right corner, a crescent moon with stars. Beneath the oval, there is text including the name "IOHANNES GADBURTUS" and additional information in Latin. The background consists of intricate line work for shading.

artworks.title: George Villiers, First Duke of Buckingham
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a person from the chest upwards. The person is facing slightly to the right but looking directly at the viewer with a composed expression. He has a moustache, beard, and curly, shoulder-length hair. The attire is elaborate with a dark, buttoned garment and a large lace ruff around the neck. Strands of beads or pearls drape down the front of his clothing. The background is a textured, dark space, and the oval frame surrounding the portrait has text at the top reading "CRUX FIDEI" and at the bottom "COTTA CULA." The style of the artwork appears to be an engraving or an etching.

artworks.title: Robert Devereux, Second Earl of Essex
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man's upper body, including his head, shoulders, and part of his chest. He is in a three-quarter position, facing slightly to the right. The man has a high forehead, arched eyebrows, and deep-set eyes, with a prominent mustache and a full, thick beard covering his jawline and chin. His hair is wavy and of medium length, falling to just above his shoulders. He is wearing a suit of armor detailed with rivets and overlapping plates, as well as a diagonal sash. The background features a dark pattern. Text at the bottom of the image identifies him as "Robert Deuereux Earle of Essex" and includes the artist's signature, "W. Dolle F."

artworks.title: Sir Henry Wotton
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up, posed in a thoughtful manner with his left cheek on his hand, leaning on a table. The man has prominent facial features with a long, pointed beard and mustache. His hair appears medium length and wavy. He is wearing a detailed coat with a fur collar and patterned sleeves, along with a high white ruffled collar. The man is seated, with his other hand on the table. The background has textured linework, and the words "PHILOSO-PHEMUR" are faintly visible. A round emblem with a heart and key design is at the bottom. The engraving "CLAVEM CLGORVT" is on the emblem. The artist's inscription "W-Dolle-F." is at the bottom right.

artworks.title: John Carter, Puritan Rector of Belstead, Suffolk
artworks.description: The image displays a man from the waist up, facing slightly left with eyes upward. He has a beard and mustache, a cap, and a high-collared garment with a ruff. He gestures with his right hand, and a book, hourglass, and ink pot with a quill pen are on the table in front of him. The background has a circular patterned border with an inscription, radiating lines, and the name "Mr John Carter" below the portrait.

artworks.title: Samuel Clarke, Minister of Saint Benet Fink, Biographer
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body. He is facing slightly to the right, holding a pen in his right hand as if he is writing on a piece of paper in front of him. The man has a rounded face with a pronounced nose and a small goatee on his chin. His hair is covered by a cap, with a few curls visible. He wears a dark, long-sleeved garment with a large, white collar embellished with a floral decoration. The sleeves end in white cuffs and the fabric has a textured, striped pattern. Two coat-of-arms symbols are above and on either side of his head. The background has horizontal lines, and there are decorative text lines below the portrait.

artworks.title: George Calvert, Lord Baltimore
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man's upper body. He is in a three-quarter pose, with his left arm resting on a surface. His head is slightly turned towards the viewer, emphasizing his facial features. He has wavy, shoulder-length hair, a distinct nose, and expressive eyes. He is dressed in a formal garment with a large collar and cape, suggesting prominence and formality. The man wears a doublet with patterned fabric and a sash across his chest, and he holds gloves in his right hand. Beneath the portrait is a coat of arms with a shield flanked by mythical creatures and surrounded by text. The background includes a curtain-like drapery and an outdoor scene with hills and a sky in the far left corner.

artworks.title: Charles, Earl of Carlisle
artworks.description: The image displays an upper-body portrait of a man standing upright. He has sharp eyes and a prominent nose, with long, curly hair flowing down to his shoulders. He is wearing formal attire that combines armor and fine fabric, including a high-collared shirt and a chest sash. The man holds a baton in his left hand, standing in front of a column with a landscape visible in the background. The detailed background shows textures of both indoor and nature settings. An inscription below the image provides information about the person's titles and achievements.

artworks.title: Thomas Osborne, First Duke of Leeds
artworks.artist: Abraham Blooteling after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a man in an oval frame. The man is facing forward with his head slightly turned to his right. He has a composed expression, a long prominent nose, and his eyes are looking outward. He has long, wavy hair cascading down past his shoulders and is wearing a garment with a decorative pattern at the collar or tie. Additional fabric is draped around his shoulders. The portrait is surrounded by an ornate oval frame with a decorative, engraved border. Below the portrait is an inscription that reads "THOMAS ASBORNE, Earl of Danby, Lord high Treasurer of England," on a block-like surface resembling part of a pedestal. The background features fine line engravings around the oval frame.

artworks.title: Thomas Osborne, First Duke of Leeds
artworks.artist: Abraham Blooteling after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring an upper-body portrait of a man in an oval frame. The man's body is forward-facing with a slight angle, showing a partial three-quarters view of his face. His facial features include a distinct nose and a slightly solemn expression. He has long, curly hair flowing over his shoulders and wears a high-collared garment with patterned details. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background consists of straight, vertical lines contrasting with the busy texture of the hair. Below the portrait is a plaque with the man's name and title, "Thomas Osborne, Earl of Danby, Lord High Treasurer of England," along with artist and engraver credits. The overall presentation suggests a formal style typical of historical engravings.

artworks.title: Edward Montagu, First Earl of Sandwich
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed black-and-white engraving of a man's upper body. He is facing forward, with distinct facial features including full lips and a serene expression. The man has long, curly hair flowing over his shoulders and is wearing ornate armor, a lace cravat, and an embellished brooch. The engraving is enclosed in an oval frame adorned with laurel leaves and decorative elements. Below the man, an emblem features a hand holding scales emerging from clouds, with the Latin text "ensis Potior Sceptro." The background consists of an etched pattern.

artworks.title: Edward Montagu, Second Earl of Sandwich
artworks.artist: Abraham Blooteling after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man with curly hair. He is looking directly at the viewer, wearing an elaborate period outfit. His hands are placed elegantly. The background has textured shading typical of engravings from that era. An inscription identifies the person in the portrait.

artworks.title: Frans Rubens
artworks.artist: Studio of Sir Peter Paul Rubens after Abraham Blooteling
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a young person in profile view facing left. The individual has a round face with large eyes and a small mouth. They have wavy hair styled with curls framing the face, and wear a garment resembling a cloak or drapery. The person also wears a decorative headpiece with lace or fabric detailing. The portrait is rendered in a monochrome style, possibly an engraving or etching, with detailed shading providing depth to the features and clothing. The background is plain to emphasize the figure and headwear.

artworks.title: George Alsop
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed etched portrait of a person. The subject is facing the viewer with a slightly tilted head. The facial features are sharp and defined, with a neutral expression. The person has long, wavy hair and is wearing a garment with a high, decorative collar. They appear to be within an ornate oval frame with intricate designs. Below the frame is an inscription in script, and a small coat of arms is visible at the bottom center. The background has concentric lines creating depth behind the figure.

artworks.title: George Alsop
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of an individual within an oval frame. The person has a long oval face, prominent eyes, long curly hair falling to the shoulders, a cap or headpiece, draped clothing with fine fabric folds, and a pleated collar. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is textured and dark, contrasting with the lighter figure. Text and a coat of arms, and labels "Bible" and "To Prayer Book," are at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Edward Hatton, Arithmetician
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man in a bust-length portrait framed in an oval border. The man faces the viewer, with long, curly hair reaching his shoulders. He has distinct facial features including an upturned mouth, wide nose, and pronounced cheeks. He wears a formal coat with a high collar and a cravat. The background is a dark, textured surface. The oval is surrounded by decorative ribbons and set against a backdrop resembling a carved stone pedestal with initials or a name at the base.

artworks.title: John Heydon, Astrologer and Rosicrucian
artworks.description: A portrait of a man is shown within an oval frame. The man is depicted from the chest upwards, facing forward with a slight turn to the left. He has distinctive facial features, including a prominent nose and deep-set eyes, and long, curly hair flowing past his shoulders. He is wearing a dark garment with an elaborately embroidered collar. The background features symbols and a shield with a coat of arms below the portrait, as well as an inscription along the edge of the oval. The image is monochromatic with intricate lines and shading, reminiscent of an engraving.

artworks.title: William Ramsay, Physician and Astrologer
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated with their head resting on their right hand, which is supported by a bent elbow on a surface or table. The person has long, wavy hair that extends past the shoulders and is wearing a garment with voluminous sleeves, each adorned with a ruffle at the cuff. The person is positioned slightly sideways toward a table that has a rectangular cloth draped over it. On the table, there is an open book and a nearby inkwell with a quill. The background of the image is a textured pattern.
